sunCloud.how_it_works: every bounty is an enzymatic reaction. the enzyme (bot/agent) + substrate (the work) → product (lesson/page/data) + enzyme (returned). the enzyme is NOT CONSUMED — it catalyzes and returns. the product is KEPT — it becomes part of the organism. the reward (💰) is the activation energy saved by using the enzyme. sunCloud consolidates all rewards into the organism's energy budget.

enzyme_classes.theorem-polymerase: replicates math patterns into applied contexts (polymerization)
enzyme_classes.biome-transferase: transfers world descriptions into primal habitats (transfer)
enzyme_classes.verb-hydrolase: breaks organism verbs into peristalsis stages (hydrolysis)

sunCloud.activation_energy: without enzymes, these reactions would take YEARS. with enzymes, they take MINUTES. the enzyme lowers the activation energy barrier. sunCloud tracks which enzymes are available and matches them to substrates.
